cohort: 502 women undergoing scheduled Cesarean delivery between 36 and 38 6/7 weeks gestation
finding: In women undergoing scheduled Cesarean delivery between 36 and 38 6/7 weeks gestation, administration of antenatal corticosteroids (ACS) was associated with similar neonatal outcomes compared to amniocentesis.
mod_finding: This study compared neonatal outcomes between women who had an amniocentesis and those who received antenatal corticosteroids before scheduled cesarean delivery prior to 39 weeks, but it did not specifically investigate the impact of mode of delivery on the outcomes.
